changes.description: Retitled from "Group points in H3 cells". The node type names hexagonal aggregation and the title named the indexing method instead, so the two shared no word and a reader had to know that H3 cells are hexagons to connect them. Flagged by the naming ratchet added 2026-10-13 under title-type-agreement; the convention's own rule is that the node type and the title must say the same thing. No contract change: ports, output, parameters and behaviour are identical, which is why this is a patch.
